title: slab-alignment-hinting-and-spill-backoff-controller
author: Diego Salazar
description: Motivation: tenant workloads with heterogeneous object sizes were causing persistent KV cache fragmentation and repeated spill cycles under load, which degraded P99 tail latency and increased IO pressure. This PR introduces two complementary runtime features: (1) slab alignment hinting for the KV allocator which groups similarly sized objects by alignment buckets to reduce internal fragmentation and improve locality; and (2) a spill backoff controller that applies exponential backoff and tenant-aware pacing to evictions/spill triggers to avoid oscillation during transient bursts. The changes include allocator heuristics, spill controller state machine, runtime flags and telemetry, unit and integration tests, and microbenchmarks against production-like traces. Key results: average resident set fragmentation decreases by ~18% on mixed-size traces; median eviction IOPS down 22%; P99 generation latency for heavy multi-tenant tail workloads improved by ~12% in our bench harness. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag kv.slab_alignment_enabled and runtime policy kv.spill_backoff.enabled; staged canary (5% tenants) -> 25% -> full. Related: ENG-1428, ENG-1981.

release_notes: Introduce slab alignment hinting to reduce KV cache fragmentation and add a tenant-aware spill backoff controller to prevent spill oscillation under bursty load. Config flags: kv.slab_alignment_enabled, kv.spill_backoff.enabled. Performance: ~18% fragmentation reduction and improved P99 latency in mixed-size workloads.

Luca Romano (2025-10-13): Spike: saw a race in eviction marker during shutdown on stress tests. Can you add a guard? Also, please document expected memory accounting changes for Dedicated customers.
Diego Salazar (2025-10-14): Fixed race by making eviction marker update idempotent and added explicit shutdown ordering in spill_controller. Docs updated in docs/ops/kv-tuning.md.
Priya Patel (2025-10-19): Approve after bench numbers and canary rollout plan added to PR description. Observability team to watch kv.bucket_occupancy and kv.spill_backoff_events.

notes_from_bench: Bench harness used production trace subset (24h mixed tenants) with 10ms baseline network latencies
Fragmentation score metric defined in docs/ops/kv-tuning.md; improvement observed across small/medium/large object mixes
Spill IOPS decreased and downstream storage bandwidth smoothing reduced bursty writes
operator_instructions: Default: feature off. To enable: set kv.slab_alignment_enabled=true and kv.spill_backoff.enabled=true in runtime config. Start with canary fraction=5% and monitor metrics: kv.fragmentation_score, kv.bucket_occupancy, kv.spill_backoff_events, storage.write_iops. If tail latency regresses, reduce canary and toggle slab_alignment.min_bucket_fill_pct.
observability_changes: Added metrics: kv_bucket_occupancy (labels: tenant, bucket), kv_spill_backoff_events (labels: tenant, reason, step), kv_fragmentation_score. Updated dashboards: KV Cache -> Fragmentation and Spillback
changelog_summary: Improved KV cache allocator to reduce fragmentation and added spill backoff controller to stabilize eviction behavior under bursty loads. Backward-compatible, feature gated, with operator tuning guidance.
